props.title: Ask AI to edit directly on the page
props.lead: Select text, blocks, or objects on a board and ask AI to polish, expand, translate, or turn them into a chart. AI edits your selection, shows where each change occurred, and lets you undo a whole turn.

content.text: Make a request on the page

Select the content to be processed, select "Let AI handle it", and then click the shortcut operation or write the request directly. The AI ​​button in the top bar of the page opens the "AI Dialogue" panel, which contains all dialogue records for this project.
Format menu after selecting text or table cell
Whiteboard selection toolbar, object right-click menu
Input box of AI dialogue panel

steps.title: Select the object and select "Let AI handle it"
steps.body: The request box will show the action object, such as "Selected text" or "2 content blocks", which can be changed to the entire page.

steps.title: Click the shortcut operation or enter the requirements
steps.body: The shortcut operations include "Retouch", "Streamline", "Expand", "Translate", "Visualize" and "Explain". "Visualize" changes the content into charts, flowcharts or tables; "Explanation" only answers in the conversation and does not change the page.

steps.title: send
steps.body: The current page will be saved before sending, and what the AI ​​reads is what you see. When there are unsaved or conflicting modifications on the page, they need to be processed first. The page is not locked during execution and you can continue editing.
steps.note: The AI ​​will first read the page in chunks and only modify the objects you selected.

steps.title: View results
steps.body: After each round, several modifications are displayed. Click "Position Modification" to jump to the modified object.
steps.result: If there are no other modifications to the page after this round, you can click "Undo this round" to restore to the version before sending.

content.text: The saving of AI is handled the same as other external modifications: it is loaded directly when you have no unsaved modifications; when there are modifications, it enters conflict processing, and the content on both sides will not be lost. Read-only pages, readers, and export pages do not display AI portals.

Select "Execution Mode" in "Settings → Agent". Both methods read and write pages by only connecting to the MCP of the current project, the difference is who calls the model. The settings only affect new conversations, existing conversations remain the same way they were created.

Where does it run and what does it do

Click on a node in the diagram to view a description. The key point is: the page is only written to the original project through the project-bound MCP, and the model credentials only pass through the task-specific local gateway.

nodes.label: page
nodes.detail: You make the request on the page. The host hands the page, the stable block ID, and the selected text to the executor.

nodes.label: Agent host
nodes.detail: Responsible for starting the executor, saving the conversation record and the page version before sending each round (used to cancel the current round).

nodes.label: Native Agent
nodes.detail: Keeps its own authentication and running configuration, uses its own model.

nodes.label: Codex SDK
nodes.detail: ShowAI Official Codex SDK installed on demand. Use separate HOME, CODEX_HOME, and session directories, and only install the ShowAI plug-in; does not inherit your API Key, Codex login, skills, or plug-in configuration. Command execution uses the workspace-write sandbox.

nodes.label: Project MCP
nodes.detail: Project-bound MCP connection. Page creation, saving, local modification as well as component and template tools are authorized to execute in this connection. Read and write inherit the current hash and revision. It does not tap into the entire content library.

nodes.label: project
nodes.detail: AI modifications are saved back to the original project and go through the same set of conflict handling as your edits in the workbench.

nodes.label: task workspace
nodes.detail: Defaults to ~/Documents/ShowAI/Agent Workspaces, separated by projects and tasks. Each conversation uses a fixed workspace.

nodes.label: native gateway
nodes.detail: Read the model supplier credentials and forward the request; the Codex subprocess only gets the gateway's task credentials. The Chat Completions source completes the format conversion here. Close after the task is completed.

nodes.label: Model source
nodes.detail: The model service you added. ChatGPT authorization is only used with the official Responses API.

content.text: The built-in agent's private copy of the plugin keeps the 8 skills but drops the launch configuration that connects to the whole library, so it can only work on the current project.
Does not switch to the CLI or another project when the connection fails.
It will generate a presentation file after saving the page, but the built-in dialog currently only delivers results in text and file links.
When continuing a conversation, it must be the same project and the same model source.
(Desktop version is located in Electron userData)

Conversations are saved by project, and each round records the complete request, action object, execution process and page results. Deleting a conversation only deletes the record and does not affect the page content.

The SDK required for "Providing LLM API" is not installed with the application. Click "One-click Install Codex SDK" in "Settings → Agent → Built-in Execution Capabilities", and later use "Check and install new version" to update.
The SDK and platform packages are downloaded from the official npm registry, unpacked after checking SHA-512 integrity, and the installation script is not executed.
Does not write to global npm, Python, or your own Codex directory.
The old version is retained until the upgrade is complete; the specific reason is displayed if it fails.
